name: RST00_JumpTable
comment: rst $00 with A = index; a dw table follows inline -> 0690

name: RST10_FarCall
comment: rst $10 ; db idx bank -> 01F6 FarCallVectorInline (jumps to bank:[$4000+idx])

name: RST18_FarCall
comment: rst $18 ; db idx bank -> 01B6 FarCall (keeps a and hl)

name: BuildStamp
comment: ascii "9908020118" + 00 (Tennis has its stamp at the same address)

bank: # --- bank 0 routines found by reading code ---

name: JumpTableDispatch
comment: rst $00 target: pops the return address as the table base and jumps to word [A] (as in Mario Tennis 00:06C4; different code)

name: MulHLBySin
comment: (as in Mario Tennis 00:0B03; its callee 0B4C matches MulHLBySinHalf)

name: LZDecompress
comment: hl = src and de = dst; returns hl = bytes written. Same format as Mario Tennis 00:1797 (tools/decompress.py)

name: SoftReset
comment: sp = $D000 then the whole init; jumped to from 2F90 (as in Mario Tennis 00:2582; partial match)

name: AdvanceFrame
comment: halts until hVBlankDone; runs 2688 and RunFrameTasks; inc wFrameCounter; soft-reset check (as in Mario Tennis 00:2631; partial match)

name: TimerHandler
comment: farcalls 7E:40EB (sound update) while the LCD is off (as in Mario Tennis 00:27D7)

name: LinkLostReset
comment: farcall 08:555F then jp SoftReset; reached from AdvanceFrame when hLinkActive and hLinkIdleCount >= $20 (link cable lost)

name: SerialHandler
comment: link protocol: $70/$71 handshake; counts idle bytes ($00/$FF) in hLinkIdleCount; $4x/$5x commands

name: GameMain
comment: farcalled by Start (rst $10 ; db $00 $01); never returns

name: CGBRequiredScreen
comment: farcalled by Start when hIsCGB = 0 (name is a guess from that branch)

bank: # --- bank 7E (sound engine: hypothesis from the callers) ---

name: SoundUpdate
comment: farcalled every frame by VBlankHandler and by TimerHandler while the LCD is off

name: hVBlankDone
comment: set by the VBlank handler; polled by AdvanceFrame / WaitVBlankFlag

name: hROMBank
comment: current ROM bank shadow (written with MBC5_ROMB0 everywhere)

name: hIsCGB
comment: 1 when the boot ROM left A = $11 (Start)

bank: # --- generated: tools/compare_home.py --labels (full shape match with a Mario Tennis home routine) ---

name: LoadText
comment: hl = text id: bank $18 + ((h >> 2) & 7) and index id & $3FF; farcalls that bank's export 0 (copy $180 bytes to wTextBuffer)

name: LoadTextShort
comment: same id decoding; farcalls export 1 (copy $20 bytes to $D880)

name: TextBank18_Load
comment: a = 0 -> TextBank18_Copy (each text bank 18-1F has the same pair of exports)

name: TextBank18_Copy
comment: e = index; offset table $4004; data $4404; a = 0: $180 bytes to $C600 / a = 1: $20 bytes to $D880 (CopyMemoryBC)

name: PrintText
comment: hl = string; draws until $00; control codes < $20 via TextControlDispatch

name: DrawGlyph
comment: a = char; 16 bytes from Font + (a - $20) * 16 into WRAM bank 7

name: ReadJoypad
comment: hJoyHeld / hJoyPressed (new presses) / hJoyRepeat (auto-repeat after $12 frames then every hJoyRepeatRate) (as in Mario Tennis 00:02EB; partial match 33/54)

name: ProcessVRAMCopyQueue
comment: VBlank: if hVRAMQueuePending runs the 10 queued copies at wVRAMCopyQueue with HDMA (as in Mario Tennis 00:052E ProcessVRAMCopyQueues; partial match)

name: MulSin
comment: hl * sin(bc) signed: negates the result of MulSinUnsigned for bit 7 of b (as in Mario Tennis 00:1351; the twin DivBySin is excluded because the callee multiplies)

name: MulSinUnsigned
comment: looks up SineTable[bc >> 3] (bit 6 of b mirrors the angle) and calls MulHLByDE (different code from Mario Tennis 00:1361)

name: ClearUnusedSprites
comment: zeroes wShadowOAM from hOAMUsed to $A0 (called by AdvanceFrame)

name: ResumeBGM
comment: if hSoundFlags bit 0: clear it and replay wCurrentBGM (as in Mario Tennis 00:2F32; partial match)

name: SyncBGMEnableFlag
comment: hSoundFlags bit 0 = [$C818] & 1; plays sound 0 when set (as in Mario Tennis 00:2F60; partial match)

name: WaitJingleEnd
comment: AdvanceFrame until hActiveJingle = 0 or a button; then replays wCurrentBGM (as in Mario Tennis 00:302A; partial match)

name: ResumeBGMAfterJingle
comment: VBlank: when hActiveJingle is set and the channels at $C4CD-C4D0 are idle; replays wCurrentBGM

name: TickSecondaryTimer
comment: frames/seconds/minutes at wPlayClock ($C0F0) up to 99:59 (as in Mario Tennis 00:2435; partial match)

name: SerialVBlankTick
comment: VBlank: restarts the serial transfer while a link is active (hFFC2)

name: InitSerialLink
comment: sends $70 and resets the link state $FFC0-$FFC9 (as in Mario Tennis 00:28B9; partial match)

name: wShadowOAM
comment: 40 sprites; copied by the OAM DMA routine at $FF80

name: wVRAMCopyQueue
comment: 10 x 8 bytes: rom bank / wram bank / src / vram bank / dst / length

name: hSCY
comment: shadow written to rSCY in VBlank

name: hSCX
comment: shadow written to rSCX in VBlank

name: hVBlankCount
comment: incremented by every VBlank that completes

name: hJoyHeld
comment: buttons held (bit 0 A ... bit 3 Start; high nibble d-pad)

name: hJoyLast
comment: held value the repeat timer compares against

name: hWindowScroll
comment: when set the VBlank handler shows SCX 0 / SCY $40 with BG map $9C00

name: hOAMUsed
comment: bytes of wShadowOAM used this frame

name: hActiveJingle
comment: set by PlaySoundCmd for jingle ids $36-$3F

name: hSerialIdleByte
comment: byte sent when nothing is queued ($10)

name: hLinkIdleCount
comment: consecutive $00/$FF bytes received; AdvanceFrame resets the game at >= $20

name: hSerialSendMode
comment: 0 idle byte / 1 block (00:30AD; count hFFC5) / other: send $40

name: SerialNextSendNibble
comment: returns b = $50 | next nibble of wSerialSendBuf (index hFFC7)

name: SerialStoreNibble
comment: a = received $5x byte: packs its nibble into wSerialRecvBuf (index hFFC6)

name: DebugBootMenu
comment: unreachable (GameMain jumps over it to 41A6): prints BuildStamp; Up/Down/A/Start/B/Right/Select pick tests

name: MapEngine
comment: never returns: per map ClearFrameTasks / RegisterFrameTask 1 = 0A:4950 / MapRun / MapTakeWarp

name: MapRun
comment: fade out; load header (MapLoadHeader) and entrance; music; graphics (0B:46DF with wMapGfx); fade in; event loop until a warp (wMapEvent+1)

name: MapEventLoop
comment: checks the event bytes $C440-$C444: warp / talk / object / sign / menu

name: MapPlaceAtEntrance
comment: finds wMapEntrance in the entrance list (else the first); position -> $C466/$C468

name: MapTakeWarp
comment: warp wMapEvent+1 ($C46B) from the warp list: 8 bytes -> $C400; wMapId = +6; wMapEntrance = +7

name: MapFindRecord
comment: a = map id -> hl = its MapTable record (the first one if not found)

name: MapIndexOf
comment: a = map id -> a = record number

name: wMapEvent
comment: 5 event bytes cleared at map start: +0 ? / +1 warp id / +2 action (A button) / +3 / +4 menu

name: wMapHeader
comment: 14 bytes: entrances / warps / init / talk / objects / ? / ?

name: wMapBank
comment: bank of the map header and its lists

name: MapDebugCoordsTask
comment: frame task 1 during maps: prints the player's coordinates with PrintHexWord when flag #32 is set
